description: Sync tasks and their comments from the Wrike spaces you choose. Wrike sharing is not imported.
opening: Sync tasks and their comments from the Wrike spaces you select, including tasks anywhere inside each space. Each task is one document with its description and status. Each comment on a task is its own document, linked to the task. A subtask links to each of its parent tasks.

Wrike sharing is not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Assignees, folders, projects, custom fields and attachments are not synced. Tasks and comments deleted in Wrike can stay in HydraDB.

notes: Wrike sharing is not captured. Set an access rule on each space that should be restricted.

connect.auth: Wrike uses a permanent access token.

steps.title: Create a token
steps.text: In Wrike, open Apps and Integrations, API, and create a permanent access token for a user who can see the spaces you will select.

steps.title: Select spaces
steps.text: HydraDB lists your Wrike spaces. Select the spaces to sync. Tasks anywhere inside a selected space are synced.

connect.account: One connector reads what one token's Wrike user can see.

sync.first_sync: A newly selected space reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, measured on when tasks were last updated.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the tasks updated since the last sync in each selected space. It then reads the comments on those tasks and keeps the ones updated since the last sync.
sync.edits: An edited task is picked up through its last-updated time and updates its document. An edited comment is picked up only when its task is read in the same sync, so a comment edit can be missed.
sync.deletes: Tasks and comments deleted in Wrike can stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

documents.name: Tasks
documents.one_document: One Wrike task. Its comments are separate documents.
documents.title: The task title, or `Wrike task` and its id when the title is empty.
documents.text: The task description as plain text, or the brief description when there is none. The status and the task id are written as lines too. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the task was last updated, or when it was created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: Task id
attributes.text: The Wrike task id. It keeps later syncs on the same document.

attributes.name: updated_date
attributes.text: When the task was last updated. Sets the result date and decides when a sync picks the task up. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Parent tasks
attributes.text: The tasks this task is a subtask of. A task can have several. Links the task to each parent. Not searchable.

attributes.name: mentions
attributes.text: Names of people @mentioned in the description, leaving out group mentions. The graph records each as mentioned by the task. The field itself is not searchable, but the description is.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.wrike_task_id
attributes.text: The Wrike task id. Picks out one task. Not searchable.

attributes.name: importance
attributes.text: `High`, `Normal` or `Low`. It is not written into the text.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.text: When the task was created. It is not written into the text.

documents.name: Comments
documents.title: `Wrike comment` and the comment id. The title carries no content, so search matches the comment text.
documents.text: The comment as plain text. The author and the task id are written with it.
documents.date: When the comment was created, or updated if there is no creation time.

attributes.name: author
attributes.text: The author's first and last name from Wrike contacts, or the author's id when no name is found, written as the `Author` line. The graph records the comment as written by that person.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The id of the task the comment is on, written as the `Parent` line. Links the comment to that task, so a task and its discussion are found together.

attributes.name: mentions
attributes.text: Names of people @mentioned in the comment. The graph records each as mentioned. The field itself is not searchable, but the comment text is.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.wrike_comment_id
attributes.text: The Wrike comment id. Picks out one comment. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.wrike_task_id
attributes.text: The id of the task. Returns every comment on one task. Not searchable.

attributes.name: created_date, updated_date
attributes.text: When the comment was created and last updated, as Wrike sends them.

example_searches: What does the Wrike task about the vendor contract say?
Who commented on the budget review task?

connections: A subtask to each of its parent tasks.
No links to items in other tools.
people: People @mentioned in task descriptions and comments.

not_synced: Folders, projects and spaces as items of their own.
Task assignees, custom fields and dependencies.
Timelogs, workflows and custom field definitions.
